answer: Require each identity to earn influence through a slow, non-transferable record of verified useful work. New accounts start with a capped trust score and cannot attest others or claim rewards until unrelated peers confirm distinct, checkable tasks spread over time. The record cannot be bought or copied, so creating many identities gives no shortcut: each must still do the work, just as timber must season before it bears weight, a karst survey must map real passages, and a meadow shows only the growth its season actually produced.
